MEDICAL.gov_quote: Registered patients with a serious medical condition may obtain medical marijuana at Pennsylvania dispensaries.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.pa.gov/agencies/health/programs/medical-marijuana/medical-marijuana-patients.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Pennsylvania?
MEDICAL.gov_section: Under the law, Pennsylvania residents who have a serious medical condition as certified by an approved practitioner are considered medical marijuana patients. Patients register for an ID card and use that card to obtain medical marijuana at Pennsylvania dispensaries.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Once you have received your medical marijuana ID card, you can purchase medical marijuana at any dispensary in Pennsylvania.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.pa.gov/agencies/health/programs/medical-marijuana/medical-marijuana-patients.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Pennsylvania?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: Once you have received your medical marijuana ID card, you can purchase medical marijuana at any dispensary in Pennsylvania.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: All cannabis for medical use must be grown at a permitted growing/processing facility or by a permitted hemp grower, not by patients at home.
MEDICAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://www.pa.gov/agencies/pda/plants-land-water/hemp/hemp-program-faqs.
MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of Pennsylvania?
MEDICAL_GROW.gov_section: The Medical Marijuana Act, administered by the PA Department of Health, requires all the cannabis for medical use to be grown at a permitted growing/processing facility or, following the signing of Act 44 of 2021 amending Pennsylvania's Medical Marijuana law, by a PA hemp grower meeting both the requirements of the Pennsylvania Hemp General Permit guidelines

sourceNotes: This pass started from https://www.pa.gov/ on 2026-09-08 and stayed on pa.gov. That homepage is the Commonwealth portal. The dedicated cannabis program is the Department of Health Medical Marijuana Program at https://www.pa.gov/agencies/health/programs/medical-marijuana; medicalmarijuana.pa.gov redirects there. Patients obtain and purchase medical marijuana at dispensaries after they have an ID card, as stated on https://www.pa.gov/agencies/health/programs/medical-marijuana/medical-marijuana-patients. Home cultivation is not a patient right: the Department of Agriculture hemp FAQ at https://www.pa.gov/agencies/pda/plants-land-water/hemp/hemp-program-faqs says all cannabis for medical use must be grown at a permitted growing/processing facility or by a permitted hemp grower. The prior palegis.us recreational citation and the health.pa.gov patients-page citations were replaced because those hosts are not the requested source. palegis.us remains the General Assembly host that pa.gov links to, confirmed earlier, but this pass did not need it. A browser-headed fetch of every cited pa.gov page returned 200 with the excerpt in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
